summary: Iteration 4 backend-only testing against the public preview URL. Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from 45 to 66 tests (new classes: TestPublicReceiptPdf, TestSendTracking, TestCalendario, TestPrenotazioni, TestLibroSoci, TestErogazioneCompensi, TestExcelExport, TestPresidentName) and added a new probe file /app/backend/tests/edge_test.py (8 validation/authorization edge cases). FIRST FULL RUN: 65/66 passed - every iteration-4 feature requested works (public token PDF unauth 200 %PDF + 404 on invalid/deleted token, email tracking last_sent_email_at/_to in GET one + list, mark-whatsapp + whatsapp-link with working public pdf_url, calendario weekly recurrence 2026-03-01->03-22 = exactly 4 slots, single-slot POST/PATCH/DELETE, tecnico->403 when creating for another tecnico, prenotazione + 409 duplicate + 409 full + DELETE prenota, libro-soci stato_socio/quota_pagata_anno, compensi 200EUR@50% -> compenso_dovuto 100 + eroga creates 'Compenso tecnico' uscita movimento + compensi/erogati record, Excel export PK zip/xlsx headers + 403 for tecnico + 401 unauth). All 45 iteration-3 regression tests still pass. ONE FEATURE FAILURE: organizzazione.president_name in the DB is still the old misspelled 'Drovelli Caivano Bruno' - the correct default only applies to a fresh insert, there is no startup migration, so every receipt PDF/email still prints the wrong president name. Additionally 7 documented input-validation/authorization defects (2 of them cause HTTP 500) and the emergent email quota gets exhausted by the prenotazione notification fan-out, which then makes POST /ricevute/{id}/send-email return 502.

critical.issue: president_name stored in db.organizzazione is 'Drovelli Caivano Bruno' - the user's definitive name 'Drovetti Cassiano Bruno' only exists as the default of _load_org(), which is used ONLY when the config doc does not exist. Result: all receipt PDFs, the public PDF and the emailed PDF still show the wrong president name. Add a startup migration ($set president_name on the existing config doc) or fix it via PATCH /organizzazione.

HTTP 500 on malformed dates. datetime.fromisoformat(payload.data) / (payload.ricorrenza_fino_al) is unguarded -> ValueError: Invalid isoformat string. Repro: {"data":"01/03/2026","ora":"18:00"} -> 500; {"data":"2026-07-01","ricorrenza_settimanale":true,"ricorrenza_fino_al":"nope"} -> 500 (traceback in backend.err.log line server.py:720). Must be 400/422 - validate with a Pydantic field_validator or try/except.

Notification fan-out is synchronous and unbounded: every booking/cancel sends an email to the tesserato + the slot tecnico + EVERY admin, one blocking HTTP call each. During testing this exhausted the emergent/Resend quota (429 'email rate limit exceeded'), after which POST /api/ricevute/{id}/send-email started returning 502 'Invio email fallito' for ~15 minutes+ (send-email passed in the first run, then failed in every later run). Move notifications to a background task, de-duplicate/batch recipients, and do not let notification traffic starve the transactional receipt email.

minor.issue: Returns 200 {ok:true} even when that tesserato was never booked in the slot ($pull matches nothing) AND still fires the 'Prenotazione annullata' emails to tesserato/tecnico/admins. Should return 404 and skip notifications when nothing was removed.

Authorization inconsistency: POST blocks a tecnico from creating a slot for another tecnico (403), but PATCH lets a tecnico set tecnico_id to another tecnico's id (200) - it reassigns the slot away from itself (and then can no longer delete it). Also tecnico_nome is NOT refreshed on tecnico_id change, leaving the denormalized name inconsistent with tecnico_id.
capacita is not validated: capacita=-3 is accepted and creates a permanently unbookable slot (len(prenotazioni) >= capacita immediately). Also durata_min accepts <= 0. Use Field(gt=0).

importo is not validated (importo=-50 accepted -> negative 'uscita' movimento that inflates the bilancio) and the target user role is not checked (erogation to an admin/non-tecnico user is accepted, e.g. tecnico_id = admin id -> 200).

No cascade to db.compensi_erogati: deleting the 'Compenso tecnico' movimento leaves an orphan record in GET /api/compensi/erogati whose movimento_id points to nothing (confirmed - orphans had to be purged manually from mongo). Also there is no DELETE endpoint for a compenso erogato at all, so a mistaken erogation cannot be undone from the UI.

Dead code: the condition `slot['data'] > max_date and user['role'] != 'admin' and user['role'] != 'tecnico'` can never be true because only admin/tecnico can authenticate today. Harmless now, but the rule will silently not apply when the 'tesserato' login is added.

quota_pagata_anno matches items whose descrizione merely CONTAINS 'tessera', so a free-text line like 'Rinnovo tessera + 10 lezioni 150EUR' counts its whole importo as membership fee. Consider a flag on the item / tipo_pacchetto instead of substring matching. Also N+1 queries: one ricevute.find per tesserato (3000 soci -> 3000 queries).

No date range required/limited: an unfiltered call returns up to 2000 slots including all recurrence copies. Also no unique index / overlap check, so identical duplicate slots (same tecnico/data/ora) can be created repeatedly.

Works as specified, but: (a) no rate limiting on token guessing (24-byte token is fine, still worth a limiter); (b) the 'annullata' 410 branch is unreachable because DELETE is physical and no endpoint sets annullata=True - dead code; (c) the public link host is hardcoded ('https://multi-tech-associate.preview.emergentagent.com') when FRONTEND_URL is unset - a wrong/expired preview host would produce dead links in real emails/WhatsApp messages. Read it from the request base URL or make FRONTEND_URL required.

action_items: Migrate organizzazione.president_name on the existing config doc to 'Drovetti Cassiano Bruno' (startup $set) - PDFs currently print 'Drovelli Caivano Bruno'
Validate SlotCreate.data / ricorrenza_fino_al (and capacita/durata_min) so malformed input returns 422 instead of HTTP 500
Make prenotazione notification emails non-blocking (BackgroundTasks) and cap recipients - the fan-out exhausted the email quota and broke POST /ricevute/{id}/send-email with 502
Return 404 (and send no email) when cancelling a prenotazione that does not exist
Block tecnico from reassigning a slot via PATCH tecnico_id, and refresh tecnico_nome when tecnico_id changes
Validate ErogaCompenso.importo > 0 and require the target user to have role='tecnico'; cascade/undo for compensi_erogati when the linked movimento is deleted
critical_code_review_comments: _load_org() only inserts defaults when the doc is missing - any change to org defaults (president name, address) silently never reaches existing installs. Add an explicit startup migration next to the tipi_pacchetto backfill.
server.py is now 1182 lines with 7 feature domains - split into routers (auth, tesserati/abbonamenti/lezioni, ricevute/public, calendario, contabilita/compensi, export) before iteration 5.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is still deprecated - migrate to the lifespan context manager.
create_slot loops one insert_one per week (up to 53 round-trips) - use insert_many.
libro_soci runs a ricevute.find() per tesserato - replace with a single aggregate/$group on tesserato_id.

email_utils maps any upstream failure (including 429 rate limit) to a generic 502 'Invio email fallito' - propagate 429 and a user-readable reason so the UI can tell 'rate limited' from 'invalid recipient'.
Still no unique index on ricevute (anno, seq) - number reuse after DELETE can collide under concurrency (carried over from iteration 3).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run serially: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -q -n 0 (do NOT edit pytest.ini; -n 0 avoids receipt-numbering races). backend_test.py = 66 feature/regression tests; edge_test.py = intentionally FAILING probes that document 7 open defects (it imports fixtures from backend_test, run it separately). Known env limitation: the emergent email provider rate-limits after ~10 sends; TestEmail::test_send_email_with_pdf and TestSendTracking::test_email_tracking_fields returned 502 on re-runs purely because the prenotazione notification fan-out (TestPrenotazioni) burned the quota - both PASSED on the first clean run, so treat a 502 there as quota, not a code regression, and consider running the email tests first or waiting between runs. TestPresidentName fails until the president_name DB migration is done. Frontend has never been tested.
rca_of_the_issue: president_name: _load_org() lazily inserts a default config doc; the doc already existed from iteration 1-3 with the misspelled name, so updating the literal in code has no effect - a $set migration is required. Calendario 500s: SlotCreate declares data/ricorrenza_fino_al as plain str, and create_slot calls datetime.fromisoformat() on them outside any try/except, so any non-ISO value escapes as ValueError -> 500. Email 502s: _notify_prenotazione awaits one provider HTTP call per recipient (tesserato + tecnico + all admins) inside the request; ~12 calls during the booking tests tripped the provider's 429 rate limit, and email_utils translates every non-2xx into HTTPException(502), which then surfaced on the unrelated send-email endpoint.
